purpose: Replace the N32 binwise isotropic velocity surrogate by the exact anisotropic marginalized velocity precision for completed development geometry 0, combine it with the frozen 2M++ density Fisher operator, and report both the preserved strong 0.8 gate and the corrected material 0.5 gate before any 64-geometry production or field inference.

authorization.authorization_basis: The user approved implementation, tests, commit/push, and one Slurm submission for the single-geometry exact joint-covariance pilot on 2026-09-01.

design.geometry_semantics: completed development mock arm-A true positions, directions, BGc variance, frozen row split, and four Gaussian-prior nuisance templates; optimistic technical geometry rather than observationally known true positions

velocity_only_exact_marginalized_nuisanc.semantics: Exact geometry-0 velocity precision with four Gaussian-prior nuisance templates marginalized; zero-density regression and baseline.

known_selection_reference_bias.semantics: Exact velocity precision plus frozen 2M++ Gaussianized-Poisson Fisher with the official selection grids, reference luminosity biases, and six population normalizations treated as known; optimistic sensitivity reference, not a physical ceiling.

normalization_marginalized_reference_bia.semantics: Exact velocity precision plus the frozen 2M++ Fisher after analytic Schur marginalization of six independent population log-normalizations with flat priors; luminosity biases remain frozen references.

design.velocity_precision: Q_v=I+A^T R^-1 A, R=I+B Lambda B^T after row-noise normalization
design.trace_probe_semantics: paired deterministic Hermitian Rademacher probes across all three scenarios; numerical covariance probes only

gate_semantics.material: outcome-aware corrected development screen, frozen before this execution and never sufficient for parent promotion
gate_semantics.strong_stretch: preserved strong-reconstruction target corresponding coherently to I>=0.8; reported but not a route-killing hard gate
gate_semantics.single_geometry_limit: no single-geometry result can reject the full route or estimate geometry uncertainty

decision_rule.normalization_marginalized_material_pass: PASS_EXACT_GEOMETRY0_NORMALIZATION_MARGINALIZED_MATERIAL_GATE_NO_PROMOTION; request separate approval for exact 64-geometry development production
decision_rule.known_passes_normalization_marginalized_: BORDERLINE_EXACT_GEOMETRY0_KNOWN_ONLY_MATERIAL_PASS_NORMALIZATION_BOTTLENECK; calibrate density normalization nuisance before production
decision_rule.known_and_normalization_marginalized_fai: COMPLETE_EXACT_GEOMETRY0_MATERIAL_GATE_FAIL_NO_ROUTE_REJECTION; do not run 64 geometries and redesign the density nuisance model
decision_rule.technical_failure: implementation or solver failure only; preserve evidence, repair without assigning a science NO-GO, and do not consume validation
decision_rule.strong_stretch_result: always report independently; no stretch outcome alone promotes or kills the route

limitations: Geometry 0 uses completed development true positions and therefore is an optimistic operator test, not an observational CF4 posterior.
The six 2M++ luminosity biases are frozen sensitivity references, not calibrated physical nuisance posteriors.
RSD, FoG, angular/radial selection calibration uncertainty, overdispersion, and model discrepancy are not marginalized.
The grid cell is 12 cMpc/h; no 0.3 cMpc/h observational or numerical resolution claim is allowed.
No likelihood datum is used, no posterior field is created, and no IC is inferred.
